labels.label: possibly

evidence.quote: Have a histologic or cytologic diagnosis of malignant solid tumor for which there are no standard of care treatment options known to confer a clinical benefit or for which the patient is ineligible or declines.
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status ≤ 2.

labels.note: Standard options remain after lenvatinib (dabrafenib/trametinib, cabozantinib); entry rests on the declines prong (run 22/34 rule).

labels.label: eligible

evidence.quote: Histologically or cytologically confirmed recurrent locally advanced (unresectable) or metastatic solid tumors with documented RAS or RAF mutations or alterations.
Part 1E: Other advanced/metastatic non-GI, non-NSCLC solid tumors with KRAS, HRAS, NRAS, BRAF, CRAF (RAF1) mutations or alterations
Prior use of experimental agents that target the KRAS/BRAF/MEK/ERK pathway.

labels.note: Metastatic BRAF V600E thyroid cancer fits Part 1E; no prior BRAF/MEK agents; standard washout from lenvatinib.

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: a. Tumor must be refractory to or have progressed following prior treatment and have no satisfactory alternative treatment options.
Have an Eastern Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1.

labels.note: Phase 1 needs no satisfactory alternative, but BRAF-directed therapy and cabozantinib remain; phase 2 groups are PDAC, NSCLC and breast only.

labels.label: eligible

evidence.quote: Diagnosis of advanced/metastatic solid tumor
Measurable or evaluable disease per RECIST version 1.1
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status ≤ 1

labels.note: Open advanced solid-tumor phase 1 with no failing criterion; standard washout from lenvatinib.

labels.label: possibly

evidence.quote: For dose escalation cohort patients: patients must have a tumor type as defined in the protocol.
Patients will have progression on or after or intolerance to most recent systemic therapy.
ECOG performance status 0-1.

labels.note: Progressing on lenvatinib; eligible tumor types are defined only in the protocol.

labels.label: eligible

evidence.quote: Patient must have differentiated thyroid cancer (DTC) with BRAF V600E mutation as determined by local testing

Patient must have had prior treatment with at least one of the following vascular endothelial growth factor receptors (VEGFR)-targeting tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI) agents for DTC: lenvatinib or sorafenib.
Patient must have radiographic progression by RECIST 1.1 over any time interval on or after most recent prior systemic treatment
Patient must not have had prior treatment with cabozantinib or any prior BRAF targeted therapy for thyroid cancer

labels.note: BRAF V600E RAI-refractory PTC progressing on lenvatinib, no prior cabozantinib or BRAF therapy; lenvatinib hypertension not stated as uncontrolled.

labels.label: eligible

evidence.quote: Part 1A - Any histologically or cytologically confirmed solid tumor malignancy that is locally advanced or metastatic and has failed standard therapy
ECOG performance status of 0-2 for Phase 1
Known liver metastasis based on imaging

labels.note: Part 1A takes any solid tumor that failed standard therapy; lung-only metastases.
